title: Extract session_autopsy and the MCP fleet out of the monorepo
objective: testsAndMisc carried 12GB of third-party MCP clones and a self-contained analyzer package that has no monorepo dependencies. Both move to kuhyx/mcp-servers. Success is: the SessionEnd hook still ingests transcripts, every registered MCP server still resolves its binary, and no history is lost.
acceptance_criteria: session_autopsy history preserved via git subtree split, not a copy
SessionEnd hook exercised end to end against a real transcript with an empty error log
All MCP command paths verified to resolve after the move (12 references across 4 config files)
The 12GB of clones is moved and gitignored, never committed; a pinned manifest + setup.sh reconstructs it
testsAndMisc pre-commit gate passes with no --no-verify
out_of_scope: third_party/agent-skills, which is unrelated to MCP and stays
verifier: bash ~/.claude/hooks/session_autopsy_end.sh against a real transcript; a script asserting every mcpServers command path exists; pre-commit run
